_comment: TV remote keycode override map for Smart Care TV.
_howto: 1. Connect a problem device via ADB.
2. Run:  adb shell getevent -l  (press each D-pad key, note the scancode)
OR:  adb logcat --pid=$(adb shell pidof com.example.mbapp) | grep 'TvRemote UNKNOWN'
3. Each unknown key press logs:  logicalId = 0xXXXXXXXX (decimal)
4. Add the decimal logicalId as a string key below with the action as value.
Valid action strings: up | down | left | right | select | back |
volumeUp | volumeDown | mute | play | pause | playPause | mediaStop |

overrides._tcl_comment: TCL — add codes found via adb getevent for the failing model
overrides._onn_comment: ONN Google TV (OSUIT21ANA001) — typically standard, no overrides needed
overrides._mbox_comment: Xiaomi Mi Box S / Mi TV Stick — standard Android keycodes, no overrides needed

device_notes.tcl_ir_vs_bt: TCL IR remotes → Android keycode 19-23 (standard). TCL BT remotes → BT HID which maps to Android HID codes — usually also standard but some older TCL BT firmware sends KEYCODE_BUTTON_L2/R2 for left/right.
device_notes.haier: Haier often uses MTK SoC (MT5816). Remote uses IR via NEC protocol. Keycodes are standard DPAD. If broken, suspect the ATV launcher consuming keys before the app.
device_notes.mi_tv: Mi TV 4A/4X and Mi Box S use standard Android DPAD keycodes. Not a keycode problem — if broken, likely a focus issue.
device_notes.onn_google_tv: ONN OSUIT21ANA001 uses standard BT HID remote. All keys standard. No overrides expected.
device_notes.rockchip_boxes: Generic Rockchip RK3328/RK3399 boxes may send BUTTON_A (96) for OK and evdev keycodes 103/108/105/106 for DPAD — already covered in the compiled-in table.
device_notes.amlogic_boxes: Amlogic S905/S912/S922X: DPAD_CENTER arrives as keycode 23 — already covered.
